items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: I was fortunate enough to hear both Happy Shilling and Brown's band

ctx.x: In the real old days, say back in the 1910 period, could you really hear that guitar? Because half the time you can't hear it.

You could if you were up close to the band, but I mean, having no microphones or anything like that, it just, I think it was for the band itself, the solid cording and the solid rhythm that they used, it helped the band itself more than it did the dancers. I think, of course, that the pieces like the blues had no business to be played on the banjo at all. Now, one of the things that I was going to completely overlook was the fact that we danced by Brown's band many times. Oh, yeah. And I followed, I used to go to…
I've been asking about Fisher's band.
